title: Someone is down.
sub: From across the plaza, the Lens has already seen it. One card, above the person.

title: You are the closest.
sub: Everything stays on the person, where you are already looking.

title: One calm step at a time.
sub: Check them. Call 911. The dispatcher connects and sees your view.

title: The guide is drawn on the body.
sub: A target on the sternum at real size. The chest gives under every push. The ring holds you at 110 a minute.

title: Never ask the crowd.
sub: A chime and an arrow lead to the AED. Point at one person.

title: Swap. Pads. Stand clear.
sub: A rescuer swap at two minutes, pads shown on the chest, and a simulated shock.

title: You did not freeze.
sub: Compressions, time on pace, best streak and time to first push.
